answer_text: Design verification MC - requires ngspice simulation to determine actual failing specs

choices.A: Quality factor Q is too low
choices.B: Passband gain does not meet the target
choices.C: Phase margin is insufficient for stability
choices.G: DC gain is below the minimum requirement
choices.H: Power consumption exceeds the maximum limit
choices.I: Cutoff frequency is outside the tolerance range
choices.J: Center frequency deviates from target by >10%

note: Design MC questions require runtime simulation - correct answer is determined dynamically
